# Test fixtures: provenance

Third-party code and third-party data are never committed. Committed fixtures are either
generated by this package's own DGPs, or are outputs of third-party programs run on those
synthetic panels. Each file is listed below with the program that produced it, its
version and licence, and its input.

## `synthetic/`: panels generated by this package

Generated by `dev/make_fixtures.jl` from `test/support/PLPDGPs.jl` (StableRNGs, fixed
seeds); `julia --project=dev dev/make_fixtures.jl --check` regenerates them and compares.

| File | Design | Seed |
|---|---|---|
| `fx_balanced.csv` | N = 30, T = 60; unit shock `x`, aggregate shock `X`, exposures `s`/`sv`, control `w`, groups `grp` (5) and `reg` (6) | 20261020 |
| `fx_unbalanced.csv` | N = 40, t ∈ 1..70, staggered entry/exit, period 35 absent, ~4% holes, singleton units 39/40, two-obs unit 38, missing `w` | 20261021 (+7) |
| `fx_dated.csv` | N = 6, quarterly `Date` 2001Q1–2010Q4, unit 2 missing 2005Q3 | 20261022 |
| `fx_cdols.csv` | Ugarte-Ruiz DGP, ρ_y = ρ_s = 0.8, β = 1, correlated effects (α = 10), N = 100, T = 50 | 20261023 |
| `fx_tlahr.csv` | Almuzara–Sancibrián stylized design (+ unit effect), ρ = 0.7, R̄² = 0.9, N = 200, T = 40 | 20261024 |
| `fx_tlahr_unbal.csv` | `fx_tlahr` with ~10% of the rows removed | 20261024 (+11) |

## `local/` (gitignored)

Outputs computed on third-party data (so far the MSS applications). Tests that need them
carry a `:local_*` tag and are skipped when the sentinel data file is absent (see
`test/runtests.jl`); with the data present, a missing output is a test failure.

| File | Tool | Input | Script |
|---|---|---|---|
| `local/mss_apps_R.csv` | Mei–Sheng–Shi `LP_panel` (FE and SPJ), as in their notebook | their four application CSVs | `crosscheck/R/mss_apps_local.R` |
| `local/mss_apps_xtlp.csv` | Stata `xtlp …, tfe m(fe \| spj) keepsingletons` (exact two-way fixed effects) | their Romer–Romer CSVs | `crosscheck/stata/mss_apps_local.do` |
